articles.summary: MasterCraft Boat Company , a subsidiary of MasterCraft Boat Holdings and the best-selling towboat brand, in partnership with the World Wake Association (WWA), today announced the official dates, locations, and event details for the five-stop 2026 MasterCraft WWA Rider Experience. Building on the relaunch of the iconic Rider Experience series announced in October, this multi-year partnership marks MasterCraft’s first return in more than a decade to supporting amateur wakeboarding and wakesurfing competition. It also reaffirms the brand’s long-standing commitment to growing participation, access, and community within watersports. Together, MasterCraft and WWA are reestablishing a premier grassroots platform designed to welcome riders of all ages and abilities, combining progression-focused competition, on-water coaching, and community-driven experiences.
